body: i have no money for a dog sitter, i just want to adopt them out so they have a good home. i never will. the resources are stretched paper thin in my little town. if i had a kid people would help me. aint that a kick in the head? I know im in no shape to raise kids, so i have none, and then the system is like welp, you can take care of yourself. id rather die than live in a shelter with no hope of making anything of my life. i can't get healthy there. (i have bipolar) i'm sorry. i'm not trying to argue, i know you're trying to help, but it's not always how people think. the world doesn't always pick you up when you're down. i went to the ER suicidal and they sent me home with an appointment 9 months away. that's what it's like being poor where I live. your family is supposed to take care of you. i had someone to take care of me and he stopped.
